## HP Flagged as Potentially Underpricing Margin Risk as AI Demand Inflates Memory and Storage Input Costs

AI capex boom is creating an input cost headwind for PC OEMs that sit downstream of the memory/storage supply chain; if HP cannot pass through cost increases, margin guidance may prove too optimistic — a risk worth stress-testing in HPQ models.

- Analysis argues HP (HPQ) may be underestimating margin risk in its current guidance or valuation
- AI hardware demand identified as the mechanism driving up memory and storage input costs
- Risk framed as relevant to HP's PC segment profitability specifically
- Single outlet (simplywall.st); cautionary/risk-flagging tone rather than a reported fact
